artifact_observations.reasoning: The background exhibits a uniform, noisy texture typical of AI-generated underwater scenes or heavy compression. It lacks the distinct particulate matter or depth variation of real underwater photography.

Several of the thin, elongated rays of the pectoral fins appear to merge slightly with the background or adjacent rays near the edges, lacking crisp separation. This is a common artifact in generating fine, semi-transparent structures.

The overwhelming cyan/teal tint is unnatural even for underwater photography (which usually retains some red/yellow spectrum unless at extreme depth, where visibility would be lower). This suggests a failure in color rendering or an artistic filter applied by the generator, obscuring class-defining features.
